entries.name: acquisition.fetches_for_url
entries.sql:
select f.id, f.origin_kind, f.origin_label, f.tool, f.tool_version, f.request_url, f.final_url,
       f.requested_at, f.completed_at, f.http_status, f.outcome, f.content_sha256, f.media_type,
       f.size_bytes, f.credits_used, f.cost_usd, f.failure_class, f.prior_capture_id
from acquisition.fetch f
where f.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or f.request_url = $1 or f.final_url = $1)
order by f.requested_at desc, f.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Fetch ledger rows for a URL (who fetched, with what tool, outcome, hash, spend)

entries.name: artifacts.by_type
entries.sql:
select a.id, a.artifact_type, a.sha256, a.bucket_class, a.storage_bucket,
       a.object_path, a.mission_id, a.created_at
from orchestration.artifact a
where a.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or a.artifact_type = $1)
order by a.created_at desc, a.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Artifacts of one artifact_type for the current tenant

entries.name: catalog.benchmark_scores
entries.sql:
select * from api.benchmark_scores
where ($1::uuid is null or subject_id = $1)
  and ($2::text is null or benchmark ilike '%' || $2 || '%')
order by benchmark, score desc nulls last
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 100), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 benchmark results as facts (one home for numbers) by subject or benchmark

entries.name: catalog.concepts
entries.sql:
select * from api.concepts
where ($1::text is null or concept ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or description ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
order by modules_covering desc nulls last, works_about desc nulls last, concept
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 concepts and techniques with how many works, software, guidance items and our modules cover them

entries.name: catalog.events
entries.sql:
select * from api.events
where ($1::text is null or event ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or series::text ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
order by starts_on desc nulls last, event
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 industry events (conference editions) with dates, place, organizers, tracks and talk counts

entries.name: catalog.model_offerings
entries.sql:
select * from api.model_offerings
where ($1::uuid is null or model_version_id = $1)
  and ($2::text is null or provider ilike '%' || $2 || '%' or model ilike '%' || $2 || '%' or offering ilike '%' || $2 || '%')
order by input_usd_per_1m nulls last, offering
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 offerings (model as sold by a provider) with normalized USD per 1M tokens and the price claim/locator

entries.name: catalog.model_offerings_at
entries.sql: select * from api.model_offerings_at($1::timestamptz) order by input_usd_per_1m nulls last, offering limit 200
entries.title: The offerings table as it stood at a world time (L2 replay of L1)

entries.name: catalog.models
entries.sql:
select * from api.models
where ($1::text is null or model ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or developer ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or model_family ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
  and ($2::text is null or availability = $2)
order by released_on desc nulls last, model
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 models (one row per model version) with developer, capabilities, availability and minimum current price

entries.name: catalog.models_at
entries.sql: select * from api.models_at($1::timestamptz) order by released_on desc nulls last, model limit 200
entries.title: The models table as it stood at a world time (L2 replay of L1)

entries.name: catalog.organizations
entries.sql:
select * from api.organizations
where ($1::text is null or organization ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
  and ($2::text is null or org_kind = $2)
order by organization
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 organizations with kind, site, country, founding date and counts

entries.name: catalog.papers
entries.sql:
select * from api.papers
where ($1::text is null or title ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or arxiv_id = $1 or doi = $1 or authors::text ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
order by published_at desc nulls last, title
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 papers with identifiers, authors, code repositories, techniques and the talks that discuss them

entries.name: catalog.people
entries.sql:
select * from api.people
where ($1::text is null or person ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or affiliations::text ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
order by talk_count desc nulls last, person
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 people with current affiliations and talk/work counts

entries.name: catalog.software
entries.sql:
select * from api.software
where ($1::text is null or kind = $1)
  and ($2::text is null or software ilike '%' || $2 || '%' or package_name ilike '%' || $2 || '%' or concepts::text ilike '%' || $2 || '%')
order by stars desc nulls last, software
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 software (libraries, repositories, MCP servers, agent skills, products, protocols) in one table

entries.name: catalog.software_releases
entries.sql:
select * from api.software_releases
where ($1::uuid is null or software_id = $1)
  and ($2::text is null or software ilike '%' || $2 || '%')
order by released_at desc nulls last, release
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Releases of a software thing, newest first, with breaking flag and the knowledge seq they were learned at

entries.name: catalog.talks
entries.sql:
select * from api.talks
where ($1::text is null or title ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or topics::text ilike '%' || $1 || '%' or speakers::text ilike '%' || $1 || '%')
  and ($2::uuid is null or event_id = $2)
order by event_starts_on desc nulls last, title
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: L1 talks with event, speakers, topics, linked repositories and recording links

entries.name: content.document_digest
entries.sql: select * from api.document_digest($1::uuid) limit 200
entries.title: Structured digest of a document's newest version (key points, entity roles, assertions, changes, open questions)

entries.name: content.document_units
entries.sql: select * from api.document_units($1::uuid, $2::text[]) limit 200
entries.title: Typed units of a document across its versions (newest first)

entries.name: content.refresh_checks
entries.sql:
select r.id, r.document_id, r.prior_version_id, r.fetch_id, r.checked_at, r.outcome, r.content_sha256, r.new_version_id
from content.refresh_check r
where r.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::uuid is null or r.document_id = $1)
  and ($2::text is null or r.outcome = $2)
order by r.checked_at desc, r.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Refresh outcomes for a document (unchanged, changed, failed) and the version each created

entries.name: content.talk_segments
entries.sql: select * from api.talk_segments($1::uuid, $2::integer, $3::integer, $4::text) limit 200
entries.title: Transcript segments and slides of a talk inside a timecode window, optionally filtered by text

entries.name: content.unit_changes
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.document_id, c.logical_key, c.unit_kind, c.from_version_id, c.to_version_id, c.change_kind,
       c.changed_attributes, c.detected_at, c.update_proposal_state
from content.unit_change c
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::uuid is null or c.document_id = $1)
  and ($2::timestamptz is null or c.detected_at >= $2)
order by c.detected_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 100), 1), 200)
entries.title: Unit-level diffs between document versions, matched by logical key

entries.name: entity.at
entries.sql: select * from api.entity_at($1::uuid, $2::timestamptz, $3::bigint)
entries.title: Facts for one entity at a world time as known at a knowledge seq

entries.name: entity.attributes
entries.sql:
select e.id as entity_id, e.kind, e.display_name, e.slug, e.lifecycle, e.summary, e.attributes,
       ek.parent_kind, ek.is_work, ek.attributes_schema
from catalog.entity e
join taxonomy.entity_kind ek on ek.code = e.kind
where e.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and e.id = $1
  and ($2::text is null or e.kind = $2)
entries.title: Canonical entity row with its kind-validated attributes and the kind's attribute schema

entries.name: entity.by_identifier
entries.sql:
select e.id as entity_id, e.kind, e.display_name, e.lifecycle, i.scheme, i.value
from catalog.entity_identifier i
join catalog.entity e on e.id = i.entity_id and e.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
where i.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and i.scheme = $1
  and i.value = $2
entries.title: Find a canonical entity by external identifier scheme and value

entries.name: entity.card
entries.sql: select api.entity_card($1::uuid) as card
entries.title: Current overview of one entity

entries.name: entity.relationships
entries.sql: select * from api.relationships($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::timestamptz, $4::bigint, $5::text)
entries.title: Relationships touching one entity at a world time and knowledge seq

entries.name: entity.resolve
entries.sql: select * from api.resolve_entity($1::text)
entries.title: Find entities by name, alias, or identifier

entries.name: entity.timeline
entries.sql: select * from api.entity_timeline($1::uuid, $2::timestamptz, $3::timestamptz, $4::bigint)
entries.title: Segments, events, and unknown gaps for one entity over a world interval

entries.name: entity.what_changed
entries.sql: select * from api.what_changed($1::uuid, $2::bigint, $3::bigint)
entries.title: Opened and closed items for one entity between two knowledge heads

entries.name: events.current_for_entity
entries.sql:
select event_id, kind, subject_entity_id, object_entity_id, occurrence_id,
       occurred_during, occurrence_mode, payload
from api.events_current
where subject_entity_id = $1
order by lower(occurred_during) desc, event_id
entries.title: Current event occurrences for one subject entity

entries.name: evidence.captures_for_source
entries.sql:
select sc.id, sc.source_id, sc.artifact_id, sc.content_sha256, sc.capture_method,
       sc.captured_at, sc.request_url, sc.acquisition_fetch_id
from evidence.source_capture sc
where sc.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and sc.source_id = $1
order by sc.captured_at desc, sc.id
entries.title: Captures registered for one source, with the acquisition fetch that produced them

entries.name: evidence.claim_support
entries.sql:
select ss.id, ss.segment_id, ss.event_occurrence_id, ss.claim_id, ss.locator_id,
       ss.role, ss.k_from, ss.k_to
from evidence.segment_support ss
where ss.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ss.claim_id = $1
order by ss.k_from, ss.id
entries.title: Segment and occurrence support rows for one claim

entries.name: evidence.claims_for_entity
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.claim_type, c.statement, c.status, c.created_at, cs.role
from evidence.claim c
join evidence.claim_subject cs on cs.claim_id = c.id and cs.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and cs.entity_id = $1
order by c.created_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 100), 1), 200)
entries.title: Claims that name one entity as subject, object, or context

entries.name: evidence.sources_by_domain
entries.sql:
select s.id, s.canonical_url, s.registrable_domain, s.host, s.publisher_entity_id,
       s.last_seen_at, s.next_revisit_after
from evidence.source s
where s.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or s.registrable_domain = $1)
order by s.last_seen_at desc nulls last, s.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Sources filtered by registrable domain

entries.name: facts.changes_since
entries.sql: select * from api.changes_since($1::timestamptz, $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[]) order by learned_at desc, change_source, subject limit 200
entries.title: What changed since a date, on both clocks (facts opened/replaced, events, unit-level document diffs)

entries.name: facts.current_by_stream
entries.sql:
select id, stream_id, stream_kind, subject_entity_id, subject_relationship_id, scope_key,
       valid_during, status, amount, currency, unit, belief, temporal_basis, k_from, k_to, payload
from api.current_facts
where ($1::text is null or stream_kind = $1)
  and ($2::uuid is null or subject_entity_id = $2)
order by stream_kind, scope_key, id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Current facts (k_to is null and valid_during contains now) by stream kind

entries.name: facts.history_for_stream
entries.sql:
select s.id, s.valid_during, s.k_from, s.k_to, s.status, s.amount, s.currency, s.unit,
       s.belief, s.temporal_basis, s.replaces_segment_id, st.scope_key
from temporal.segment s
join temporal.stream st on st.id = s.stream_id and st.tenant_id = s.tenant_id
where s.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and st.subject_entity_id = $1
  and st.kind = $2
  and st.scope_key = coalesce($3, '')
order by s.k_from, lower(s.valid_during)
limit least(greatest(coalesce($4, 50), 1), 200)
offset greatest(coalesce($5, 0), 0)
entries.title: All segments on one entity stream slot, including closed history

entries.name: facts.locators
entries.sql: select * from api.fact_locators($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::text)
entries.title: A current fact with its claim, exact locator, capture and the typed unit it was read from

entries.name: facts.price_history
entries.sql: select * from api.price_history($1::uuid, $2::text)
entries.title: Every price segment of an offering and meter with both clocks, including superseded beliefs

entries.name: guidance.items
entries.sql:
select * from api.guidance_items
where ($1::text is null or kind = $1)
  and ($2::uuid is null or subject_entity_ids @> array[$2::uuid])
  and ($3::text is null or title ilike '%' || $3 || '%' or statement ilike '%' || $3 || '%')
order by created_at desc, id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($4, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Expert guidance items (problems, solution patterns, failure modes, …) with their subject entities

entries.name: knowledge.head
entries.sql: select knowledge_seq, updated_at from api.knowledge_head()
entries.title: Current tenant knowledge sequence

entries.name: ours.modules_affected_by_release
entries.sql: select * from api.modules_affected_by_release($1::uuid)
entries.title: Our head revisions that bind or require the software a release belongs to and were authored before it

entries.name: ours.works_authored
entries.sql:
select * from api.works_authored
where ($1::text is null or kind = $1)
  and ($2::boolean is null or released = $2)
  and ($3::text is null or title ilike '%' || $3 || '%' or covers_concepts::text ilike '%' || $3 || '%' or uses_software::text ilike '%' || $3 || '%')
order by created_at desc, slug
limit least(greatest(coalesce($4, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Our courses, modules, lessons, activities, reports and templates at head revision (lens ours, tier 1)

entries.name: ranking.leaderboard
entries.sql: select * from api.leaderboard($1::text, $2::integer)
entries.title: Latest published edition of a named leaderboard (ranked entities with the fact segments behind each score)

entries.name: receipts.for_intent
entries.sql:
select i.id as intent_id, i.intent_type, i.idempotency_key, i.approval_state, i.created_at,
       i.mission_id, b.knowledge_seq, b.receipt_id, b.recorded_at, b.summary
from orchestration.operation_intent i
left join temporal.knowledge_batch b
  on b.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and b.idempotency_key = i.idempotency_key
where i.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and i.id = $1
entries.title: Intent row and sealed batch for one operation intent

entries.name: receipts.recent_for_mission
entries.sql:
select i.id as intent_id, i.intent_type, i.approval_state, i.created_at, i.idempotency_key,
       b.knowledge_seq, b.receipt_id, b.recorded_at
from orchestration.operation_intent i
left join temporal.knowledge_batch b
  on b.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and b.idempotency_key = i.idempotency_key
where i.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and i.mission_id = $1
order by i.created_at desc, i.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 20), 1), 200)
entries.title: Recent intents and sealed batches for one mission

entries.name: relationships.current_by_kind
entries.sql:
select *
from api.current_relationships
where ($1::text is null or kind = $1)
  and ($2::uuid is null or from_entity_id = $2 or to_entity_id = $2)
order by kind, id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Current relationships, optionally filtered by kind or endpoint

entries.name: retrieval.evidence_packet
entries.sql: select api.evidence_packet($1::uuid) as packet
entries.title: One evidence packet with members and node timecodes

entries.name: retrieval.hybrid_search
entries.sql: select * from api.hybrid_knowledge_search_1536($2::uuid, $3::text, $1::extensions.halfvec, $4::jsonb, $5::integer)
entries.title: Hybrid search over a published 1536-d vector-space version (legacy per-space entry; prefer retrieval.search_unified)

entries.name: retrieval.search_unified
entries.sql:
select * from api.search_unified($1::text, null, $2::text[], $3::smallint[], $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::text[], $7::uuid[],
                                 $8::timestamptz, $9::uuid[], $10::text[], $11::text[], least(greatest(coalesce($12, 20), 1), 200))
entries.title: L3 scoped semantic search over the one stack (lexical channels; the executor adds the ANN channel when it embeds)

entries.name: staging.candidates_for_kind
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.proposed_kind, c.proposed_payload, c.resolved_entity_id, c.source_id, c.created_at
from staging.candidate c
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or c.proposed_kind = $1)
order by c.created_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Staging candidates of one proposed entity kind

entries.name: staging.unresolved
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.proposed_kind, c.proposed_payload, c.source_id, c.created_at
from staging.candidate c
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and c.resolved_entity_id is null
  and not exists (
    select 1 from staging.resolution_decision d
    where d.candidate_id = c.id and d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
      and d.decision in ('create', 'match', 'reject')
  )
order by c.created_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($1, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Candidates with no create, match, or reject decision

entries.name: vocab.event_kind
entries.sql:
select code, subject_kinds, object_kinds, starts_stream_kind, ends_stream_kind, description
from temporal.event_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
order by code
entries.title: Event-kind vocabulary

entries.name: vocab.relationship_kind
entries.sql:
select code, from_kinds, to_kinds, temporal, "symmetric", inverse_label, description, property_schema
from taxonomy.relationship_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
order by code
entries.title: Relationship-kind vocabulary with endpoint constraints

entries.name: vocab.stream_kind
entries.sql:
select code, subject_mode, subject_kinds, status_values, requires_amount, unit_values,
       requires_ref_entity, ref_entity_kinds, payload_schema, description
from temporal.stream_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
order by code
entries.title: Stream-kind vocabulary and slot rules

entries.name: vocab.unit_kind
entries.sql:
select code, version, status, description, is_universal, applicable_document_types, parent_kinds,
       logical_key_attributes, selector_kind, retrieval_role, entity_roles, attributes_schema
from content.unit_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
  and ($2::text is null or $2 = any(applicable_document_types) or is_universal)
order by code
entries.title: Unit-kind grammar (typed units, logical-key attributes, locator kind, retrieval role, entity roles)
